title: "Benchmarking nf-core/taxprofiler pipeline execution"
author: "James Fellows Yates"
format: html
---

## Introduction

The notebook describes the set up of the execution of the nf-core/taxprofiler benchmarking run.

## Requirements

Command line tools used in this notebook includes:

  - `nextflow` (version 25.10.4 build 11173)

## Retrieving pipeline

We will benchmarking with v2.1.0 of nf-core/taxprofiler with Nextflow version 25.10.4.

```{bash}
#| eval: false

nextflow pull nf-core/taxprofiler -r 2.0.0
```

## Pipeline execution

Make a fresh screen session for safety

```{bash}
#| eval: false
screen -R txp
```

## Execution (Ancient DNA Illumina)

We can then run nf-core/taxprofiler on this dataset of 3 differently depth-sequenced samples with the databases we generated previously.  

### 30k

(Note: we had to run on different infrastructure due to wall-time restrictions, compared to the smaller database runs)

For example, for the full dataset of just under ~30,000 genomes:

```{bash}
#| eval: false
nextflow run nf-core/taxprofiler \
 -r 2.0.0 \
 --input /vol/permanent/benchmarking/samplesheets/taxprofiler-samplesheet_denbi.csv \
 --databases /vol/permanent/benchmarking/samplesheets/taxprofiler-databases_denbi30000.csv \
 -name txp_benchmark_30000 \
 --outdir /vol/permanent/benchmarking/taxprofiler/results_illumina_30000/ \
 --perform_shortread_qc \
 --shortread_qc_dedup \
 --perform_shortread_complexityfilter \
 --perform_shortread_redundancyestimation \
 --perform_shortread_hostremoval \
 --hostremoval_reference /vol/permanent/benchmarking/reference/human-t2t-hla.fa.gz \
 --shortread_hostremoval_index /vol/permanent/benchmarking/reference/ \
 --run_bracken \
 --run_centrifuge \
 --run_diamond \
 --run_ganon \
 --run_kaiju \
 --run_kmcp \
 --run_kraken2 \
 --run_krakenuniq \
 --run_melon \
 --run_metacache \
 --run_metaphlan \
 --run_motus \
 --run_sylph \
 --run_profile_standardisation \
 --run_krona \
 --taxpasta_taxonomy_dir /vol/permanent/benchmarking/auxiliary_files/ \
 --sylph_taxonomy /vol/permanent/benchmarking/auxiliary_files/sylph_taxonomy.tsv \
 -c custom.config
```

The configuration file used was:

```{groovy}
process {
        withName: 'FASTP_PAIRED' {
                cpus   = 20
                memory = '100.GB'
        }
        withName: 'NONPAREIL_NONPAREIL' {
                ext.args = "-k 15"
        } 
        withName: 'KAIJU_KAIJU' {
                memory = '100.GB'
                cpus   = '20'
        }
        withName: 'GANON_CLASSIFY' {
                memory = '100.GB'
                cpus   = '20'
        }
        withName: 'KMCP_PROFILE' {
                memory = '400.GB'
                cpus = '20'
                time = '365.d'
        }
        withName: 'KRAKEN2_KRAKEN2'{
                memory = '100.GB'
                cpus   = '20'
        }
        withName: 'BRACKEN_BRACKEN'{
                memory = '120.GB'
                cpus   = '20'
        }
        withName: 'METACACHE_QUERY' {
                memory = '100.GB'
                cpus = '20'
        }
        withName: 'KRAKENUNIQ_PRELOADEDKRAKENUNIQ' {
                memory = '900.GB'
                cpus = '56'
        }
        withName: 'CENTRIFUGE_CENTRIFUGE' {
                memory = '400.GB'
                cpus = '20'
                time = '365.d'
        }
        withName: 'TAXPASTA_MERGE' {
                errorStrategy = 'ignore'
                memory = '24.GB'
                cpus = '1'
        }
}
```

The final custom config (optimised for use on this particular infrastructure) on the two infrastructures used for testing was:

```{groovy}
process {
	withName: 'FASTP_PAIRED' {
		cpus   = 24
		memory = '110.GB'
	}
	withName: 'NONPAREIL_NONPAREIL' {
		ext.args = { "-k 12" } ## aDNA reads are very short
	} 
        withName: 'KAIJU_KAIJU' {
                memory = '100.GB'
                cpus   = '18'
        }
        withName: 'GANON_CLASSIFY' {
                memory = '72.GB'
                cpus   = '18'
        }
        withName: 'KRAKEN2_KRAKEN2'{
                memory = '240.GB'
                cpus   = '72'
        }
        withName: 'BRACKEN_BRACKEN'{
                memory = '240.GB'
                cpus   = '72'
        }
        withName: 'METACACHE_QUERY' {
                memory = '240.GB'
                cpus = '72'
        }
        withName: 'KRAKENUNIQ_PRELOADEDKRAKENUNIQ' {
                memory = '2047.GB'
                cpus = '72'
                time = '24.h'
        }
        withName: 'CENTRIFUGE_CENTRIFUGE' {
                memory = '2047.GB'
                cpus = '72'
                time = '24.h'
        }
	withName: 'TAXPASTA_MERGE' {
		errorStrategy = 'ignore' ## Due to bug in MetaPhlAn
		memory = '24.GB'
		cpus = '1'
		time = '4.h'
	}
}


```

### Aggregation

```{bash}
#| eval: false
## WHILE IN `taxprofiler/`
mkdir -p ../resource_tracking/taxprofiler_illumina/
for i in results_illumina_*; do du --max-depth 1 $i >> ../resource_tracking/taxprofiler_illumina/taxprofiler_illumina_resource_usage_raw.tsv; done
for i in results_illumina_*; do du -h --max-depth 1 $i >> ../resource_tracking/taxprofiler_illumina/taxprofiler_illumina_resource_usage_humanreadable.tsv; done
```

To get all trace files

```{bash}
for i in results_illumina_*; do
  mkdir ../resource_tracking/taxprofiler_illumina/"$i"/
  cp -r "$i"/pipeline_info/ ../resource_tracking/taxprofiler_illumina/"$i"/pipeline_info/
done
```

## Execution (Nanopore dataset)

We do not run MetaPhlan due to a known problem with <= v4.1 (the version in nf-core/taxprofiler) and long read data, where BowTie2 would require too much memory.

### 30k

```{bash}
#| eval: false
nextflow run nf-core/taxprofiler \
 -r 2.0.0 \
 --input /raven/ptmp/jfellowsy/projects/taxprofiler-createtaxdb-paper/benchmarking/samplesheets/taxprofiler-samplesheet_ont_raven.csv \
 --databases /raven/ptmp/jfellowsy/projects/taxprofiler-createtaxdb-paper/benchmarking/samplesheets/taxprofiler-databases_raven30000.csv \
 -profile mpcdf,raven \
 -name txp_benchmark_ont_30000 \
 --outdir /ptmp/jfellowsy/projects/taxprofiler-createtaxdb-paper/benchmarking/taxprofiler/results_ont_30000/ \
 --perform_longread_qc \
 --perform_longread_hostremoval \
 --hostremoval_reference /raven/ptmp/jfellowsy/projects/taxprofiler-createtaxdb-paper/benchmarking/taxprofiler/reference/human-t2t-hla.fa.gz \
 --longread_hostremoval_index /raven/ptmp/jfellowsy/projects/taxprofiler-createtaxdb-paper/benchmarking/taxprofiler/reference/human-t2t-hla.mmi \
 --run_bracken \
 --run_centrifuge \
 --run_diamond \
 --run_ganon \
 --run_kaiju \
 --run_kmcp \
 --run_kraken2 \
 --run_krakenuniq \
 --run_melon \
 --run_metacache \
 --run_motus \
 --run_sylph \
 --run_profile_standardisation \
 --run_krona \
 --taxpasta_taxonomy_dir /ptmp/jfellowsy/projects/taxprofiler-createtaxdb-paper/benchmarking/auxiliary_files/ \
 --sylph_taxonomy /ptmp/jfellowsy/projects/taxprofiler-createtaxdb-paper/benchmarking/auxiliary_files/sylph_taxonomy.tsv \
 -c custom_small_ont.config
```

The config: `custom_small_ont.config` contained:

```{groovy}
#| eval: false
process {
	withName: 'FASTP_PAIRED' {
		cpus   = 24
		memory = '90.GB'
	}
  withName: 'PORECHOP_ABI' {
          cpus = 24
          memory = '110.GB'
  }
  withName: 'NANOQ' {
          cpus = 24
          memory = '110.GB'
  }
	withName: 'SAMTOOLS_STATS' {
		memory = '32.GB'
	}
	withName: 'NONPAREIL_NONPAREIL' {
		ext.args = "-k 15"
	} 
  withName: 'KAIJU_KAIJU' {
          memory = '50.GB'
          cpus   = '30'
  }
  withName: 'GANON_CLASSIFY' {
          memory = '15.GB'
          cpus   = '30'
  }
	withName: 'DIAMOND_BLASTX' {
		memory = '50.GB'
		cpus = '30'
	}
	withName: 'KMCP_PROFILE' {
		memory = '50.GB'
		cpus = '30'
		time = '24.h'
	}
	withName: 'KMCP_SEARCH' {
		memory = '50.GB'
		cpus = '30'
	}
  withName: 'KRAKEN2_KRAKEN2'{
          memory = '100.GB'
          cpus   = '30'
  }
  withName: 'BRACKEN_BRACKEN'{
          memory = '10.GB'
          cpus   = '30'
  }
  withName: 'METACACHE_QUERY' {
          memory = '100.GB'
          cpus = '30'
  }
  withName: 'KRAKENUNIQ_PRELOADEDKRAKENUNIQ' {
          memory = '500.GB'
          cpus = '72'
          time = '24.h'
  }
  withName: 'CENTRIFUGE_CENTRIFUGE' {
          memory = '100.GB'
          cpus = '30'
          time = '24.h'
  }
	withName: 'TAXPASTA_MERGE' {
		errorStrategy = 'ignore'
		memory = '24.GB'
		cpus = '1'
		time = '4.h'
	}
	withName: 'MOTUS_PROFILES' {
		memory = '50.GB'
		cpus = 30
	}
	withName: 'SYLPH_PROFILE'{
		memory = '30.GB'
		cpus = 30
	}
	withName: 'MELON' {
		memory = '64.GB'
		cpus = 30
	}
	withName: 'MOTUS_PREPLONG' {
		memory = '8.GB'
		cpus = 8
		time = '16.h'
	}
	
}

```

### Aggregation

```{bash}
#| eval: false
## WHILE IN `taxprofiler/`
mkdir -p ../resource_tracking/taxprofiler_ont/
for i in results_ont_*; do du --max-depth 1 $i >> ../resource_tracking/taxprofiler_ont/taxprofiler_ont_resource_usage_raw.tsv; done
for i in results_ont_*; do du -h --max-depth 1 $i >> ../resource_tracking/taxprofiler_ont/taxprofiler_ont_resource_usage_humanreadable.tsv; done
```

To get all trace files

```{bash}
for i in results_ont_*; do
  mkdir ../resource_tracking/taxprofiler_ont/"$i"/
  cp -r "$i"/pipeline_info/ ../resource_tracking/taxprofiler_ont/"$i"/pipeline_info/
done
```
